تسترزقون (form X)
# تَسْتَرْزِقُونَ (tastarziqūna) /tas.tar.zi.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْزَقَ (istarzaqa)
# تُسْتَرْزَقُونَ (tustarzaqūna) /tus.tar.za.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَرْزَقَ (istarzaqa)
